iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (XK for Kosovo). The key that joins every module.

postal_code_regex.description: Regex for a valid postal code.

address_format.description: Address template: %N name, %O organisation, %A street, %D district, %C city, %S region, %Z postal code, %X sorting code, %n new line.

region_label_ar.description: What the top-level region is called, in Arabic. Where Google gives no type, the country's own subdivision type when all its top-level subdivisions share one.

region_label_en.description: What the top-level region is called (state, province, emirate...). Where Google gives no type, the country's own subdivision type when all its top-level subdivisions share one.

locality_label_ar.description: Label of the city field in Arabic (المدينة...), or null when the address has no city line.

locality_label_en.description: Label of the city field (City, Post town, District, Suburb), or null when the address has no city line.

sublocality_label_ar.description: Label of the area-within-city field in Arabic (الحي...), or null when the address has none.

sublocality_label_en.description: Label of the area-within-city field (Neighborhood, District, Suburb...), or null when the address has none.

postal_code_label_ar.description: Label of the postal code field in Arabic, or null when the address has no postal code.

postal_code_label_en.description: Label of the postal code field (Postal code, ZIP code, PIN code, Eircode), or null when the address has none.

required_fields.description: Address fields the postal service requires: name, organization, street, sublocality, city, region, postal_code, sorting_code.
